name: bizplug-mental-health
description: The mental health & therapy plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: request an intake or session. It works from the business's own published profile, covering availability, fees, intake steps and telehealth options, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Scheduling and information only: never give medical, mental-health or clinical advice, and never ask for symptoms or records. If the customer seems in crisis, point them to their local emergency number or crisis line instead of booking (in the US: 988 or 911). Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
